description: This bar chart illustrates the number of factual errors observed for two question answering (QA) systems, NoR QA and OneR QA, across four datasets: 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC, while the vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, labeled as such, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 and tick marks at intervals of 5. For each dataset, there are two bars grouped side-by-side: an orange bar representing NoR QA and a dark red bar representing OneR QA. The NoR QA bars have heights of approximately 15, 29, and 15 for 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC respectively, with exact values of 15, 29, and 15. The OneR QA bars have heights of approximately 10, 23, and 11 for 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC respectively, with exact values of 10, 23, and 11. The bars are not visually emphasized with any shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
